profile.description: Claude Sonnet 4.5 represents a major leap forward in AI capability and alignment. It is the most advanced model released by Anthropic to date, distinguished by dramatic improvements in reasoning, mathematics, and real-world coding. Supports 200k tokens of context - Anthropic retired the 1M-token beta for this model on 2026-04-30 (platform.claude.com/docs/en/release-notes/api).
